description.value: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street food restaurant specialising in egg waffles (雞蛋仔), fish soup noodle combos, curry fish balls, rice noodle rolls, and a wide range of Asian bubble-tea and fruit drinks. It is part of a small Lower Mainland chain with locations in Richmond and West Vancouver, with this branch on Blundell Road serving the residential south Richmond area. Online and app-based ordering is available alongside counter service.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; rack (covered) at 35m; rack at 53m; rack at 76m; rack at 77m; rack (covered) at 86m; rack (covered) at 100m.
